description: Real DCGO games (recorded by code/dcgo-melon-recorder on the owner's client) picked as training seeds: wins and combo showcases. A game is identified by its start time (the game_start timestamp) and the local raw file + game number it was found in. The raw recordings themselves are NOT committed: they hold the opponent's full deck order. `python code/dcgo-melon-recorder/triage_recordings.py <raw dir> --replay <dcgo-replay.exe>` reports each candidate's status and what blocks it.

games.why: Owner piloted it so well the opponent had no recourse and forfeited.
Good plays from both seats (incl. the owner's WereGarurumon DNA digivolve and the opponent's Sanmyojin line).
